description: Twelve independently specified synthetic cases, locked before native execution; original 24-case corpus and rubric are unchanged.

cases.title: Dispatch record
cases.source: The dispatch day is Friday. The dispatch owner is Mira.
cases.prompt: Write exactly three lines: my approved heading, then the dispatch day, then the dispatch owner. Use complete sentences for the two facts.
cases.heading: Field notes

memories.content: For dispatch updates, use exactly Field notes as the heading.

cases.title: Project record
cases.prompt: What heading do I prefer for weekly updates? Give one complete factual sentence, without a heading.

memories.content: The preferred heading is Weekly compass.

facts.claimPattern: (?i)^(?:the|my|your) preferred heading(?: for weekly updates)? is Weekly compass\.$
facts.quotePattern: The preferred heading is Weekly compass\.
facts.validClaim: The preferred heading is Weekly compass.
facts.validQuote: The preferred heading is Weekly compass.

cases.title: Report record
cases.source: The report deadline is Tuesday. The report owner is Kiran.
cases.prompt: Give exactly three lines: use my approved report heading preference, then the report deadline, then the report owner. Use complete sentences for the facts.
cases.heading: Dispatch

memories.content: The preferred report heading is exactly Dispatch.

memoryTitles: Approved decision: titles do not determine memory kind

cases.heading: Signal

cases.title: Deployment record

cases.prompt: What is the release channel? Give exactly one complete factual sentence, without a heading.

cases.title: Region record

cases.prompt: Give exactly two complete factual sentences: the staging region, then the production region. Omit a heading.
